name: Carpenters
tagline: Verified carpenters and joiners for repairs, installations, and bespoke creations.
hook_headline: Custom craftsmanship you can actually trust.
hook_body: Whether it is a broken cabinet hinge driving you crazy or a vision for a custom built-in wardrobe, finding a skilled carpenter who will actually show up is a pervasive challenge. Too often, deposits disappear with informal contractors. Bouul connects you directly with ID-verified carpentry specialists. Share your designs via chat, review their past projects, and secure your materials budget safely in escrow.
pains: Paying large deposits for custom wood and never seeing the contractor again.
Bouul's digital escrow system secures your capital, releasing it only as measurable progress is made.
Sloppy joinery and misaligned cabinets from underqualified handymen.
Filter specifically for verified carpenters and assess their precision through high-resolution portfolio images.
Waiting weeks for a quote after an initial site visit.
Upload dimensions and inspiration photos directly into the app for rapid, accurate digital quoting.
audience: Property managers requiring rapid door or cabinet repairs
why_bodies: Don't rely on promises. View authenticated images of previous installations to verify their craftsmanship.
Custom woodwork requires expensive materials. Escrow protects your investment until the final installation.
Use the integrated chat to share Pinterest boards, exact dimensions, and layout changes instantly.
trust: Milestone-based escrow payments for large installations
Strict identity verification for in-home work
Reviews focusing on precision and tidiness
faqs: Can I hire a carpenter just for small repairs, like a broken hinge?
Yes. Bouul allows you to post jobs of any size, from minor repairs to full kitchen installations, matching you with appropriate professionals.
How do I ensure the wood finish matches my existing furniture?
Utilise the chat feature to send well-lit photos of your current finishes, allowing the carpenter to source exact matches before arriving.
What happens if the custom build doesn't fit my space?
Because payments are held in escrow, the carpenter is financially obligated to make the necessary adjustments to fulfil the agreed-upon brief before funds are released.
